policies.title: Data Privacy for Students
policies.description: Student data must be encrypted at rest and in transit.

policies.title: Continuous Assessment Tracking
policies.description: The system must track continuous assessments and generate reports on a semester basis.

policies.title: Outcome Based Education (OBE) Mapping
policies.description: The ERP must support mapping of course outcomes to program outcomes.

policies.title: Faculty Workload Management
policies.description: Faculty workload must be tracked and constrained to recommended hours per week.

policies.title: Microservices Migration
policies.description: Monoliths should be incrementally decoupled using API gateways and event buses.
